foodMatrices.name: Fresh-Cut Romaine Lettuce & Baby Spinach (Low-Fat Leafy Greens, High Surface Area)
foodMatrices.oxidationSensitivity: Low lipid oxidation risk; moderate chlorophyll bleaching risk at extreme ozone exposures (> 1,200 ppm)
foodMatrices.description: High-risk raw agricultural commodity with extensive micro-crevices and stomata where bacterial biofilms anchor; requires high ozone and reactive nitrogen species penetration while preserving chlorophyll vibrancy and leaf turgor.

foodMatrices.name: Fresh Raw Chicken Breast Fillets (High-Protein, Moderate Lipid, Surface Biofilm)
foodMatrices.oxidationSensitivity: Moderate: Polyunsaturated phospholipid fatty acids in surface membranes susceptible to lipid hydroperoxide formation (TBARS limit 1.2 mg MDA/kg)
foodMatrices.description: Perishable poultry product requiring rapid surface pathogen sterilization without inducing meat color browning (metmyoglobin formation) or rancidity in skin and fat layers.

foodMatrices.name: Ready-to-Eat (RTE) Sliced Turkey Deli Meat (Pre-Cooked, Lipid-Rich, Biofilm Vulnerable)
foodMatrices.oxidationSensitivity: High: Pre-cooked cured poultry fats oxidize rapidly under excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS), causing warm-over off-flavors and volatile hexanal notes
foodMatrices.description: High-consequence deli food regulated under USDA-FSIS 9 CFR § 430 requiring zero-tolerance Listeria control; cold plasma must inactivate slice-interface biofilms without pushing TBARS past commercial rancidity limits.

foodMatrices.name: Fresh Strawberries & Blueberries (Acidic Soft Fruit, Fungal Spores & Viral Vectors)

foodMatrices.oxidationSensitivity: Low lipid risk; high anthocyanin pigment and ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) antioxidant oxidation sensitivity
foodMatrices.description: Delicate fresh berries highly susceptible to post-harvest grey mold rot and viral transfer; requires mild diffuse cold plasma to destroy fungal spores without softening fruit skin or bleaching natural anthocyanin red pigments.

foodMatrices.name: Shelled Raw Walnuts & Almond Kernels (High-Fat Polyunsaturated Nuts, Low Moisture)
foodMatrices.oxidationSensitivity: Extreme: Linoleic and linolenic polyunsaturated fatty acids oxidize instantaneously, generating peroxide values > 10 meq/kg and bitter aldehydes if ozone exceeds 400 ppm
foodMatrices.description: Extremely oil-dense food matrix requiring low-ozone, nitrogen-dominated reactive nitrogen species (RNS) treatment to eliminate surface Salmonella without initiating free-radical chain lipid autoxidation.

gasFormulations.name: Modified Atmosphere High-Oxygen Mix (65% O2 / 30% CO2 / 5% N2, Ultra-High ROS/Ozone)
gasFormulations.pathogenLethalityKinetics: Rapid: Dominant ozone and singlet oxygen penetrate cell membranes, inducing immediate cell wall lipid peroxidation and lysis within 30-60 seconds
gasFormulations.lipidOxidationRisk: Very High: High O3 headspace concentrations (> 1,500 ppm) rapidly oxidize surface unsaturated fatty acids in meat and nuts
gasFormulations.description: Standard commercial MAP blend for red meat and produce that converts into an exceptionally potent reactive oxygen cocktail during electrical discharge, yielding the highest pathogen kill rates.

gasFormulations.name: Ambient Compressed Dry Air (78% N2 / 21% O2 / 1% Ar, Balanced ROS/RNS Cocktail)
gasFormulations.primaryReactiveSpecies: Ozone (O3), Nitric Oxide (•NO), Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Peroxynitrite (ONOO-)
gasFormulations.pathogenLethalityKinetics: Balanced: Simultaneous reactive oxygen and nitrogen chemistry; peroxynitrite and nitrous acid acidify cell surface while ozone oxidizes proteins
gasFormulations.lipidOxidationRisk: Moderate: Balanced ROS generation allows wide operating window for produce and poultry if exposure time is controlled under 120 seconds
gasFormulations.description: Cost-effective, versatile working gas utilizing filtered dry air; generates a synergistic balance of bactericidal ozone, nitrogen dioxide, and peroxynitrite radicals.

gasFormulations.name: Nitrogen-Enriched Low-Oxygen Mix (90% N2 / 10% O2, Dominant RNS, Low Oxidation)
gasFormulations.primaryReactiveSpecies: Nitric Oxide (•NO), Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Dinitrogen Trioxide (N2O3), Atomic Nitrogen
gasFormulations.pathogenLethalityKinetics: Moderate to High: RNS species react with cell surface moisture to form nitrous and nitric acids, driving oxidative nitration of tyrosine residues and DNA deamination
gasFormulations.lipidOxidationRisk: Very Low: Minimal ozone formation prevents lipid peroxidation and rancid hexanal odors, making it ideal for fatty meats and tree nuts
gasFormulations.description: Engineered low-oxygen plasma gas specifically formulated for lipid-dense matrices, suppressing free-radical lipid chain reactions while harnessing reactive nitrogen bactericidal pathways.

gasFormulations.name: Noble Gas Carrier Mix (98% Argon / 2% O2, Penning Ionization, Mild Diffuse Glow)
gasFormulations.primaryReactiveSpecies: Argon Metastables (Ar*), Low-Level Ozone, UV-C Vacuum Photons (200-280 nm)
gasFormulations.pathogenLethalityKinetics: Mild: Penning ionization and deep UV photolysis disrupt microbial nucleic acids with negligible chemical etching of package polymers
gasFormulations.lipidOxidationRisk: Negligible: Near-zero oxidative stress preserves fresh fruit aromas, color pigments, and delicate nut oils
gasFormulations.description: Specialized inert carrier gas producing uniform low-temperature diffuse glow discharge with low breakdown voltage, ideal for ultra-delicate berry and pharmaceutical packaging.

regulatoryStandards.title: Threshold of Regulation for Cold Atmospheric Plasma & Ozone as Antimicrobial Food Treatment
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Plasma-generated chemical species must not leave toxic chemical residues (such as chlorate or excessive nitrosamines). Ozone is recognized as GRAS for direct food contact when applied at levels consistent with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).

regulatoryStandards.title: Control of Listeria monocytogenes in Post-Lethality Exposed Ready-to-Eat Meat Products
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Requires validated post-packaging lethality treatments to achieve at least a 1-log to 5-log reduction of Listeria monocytogenes, with ongoing verification of packaging hermetic seal integrity.

regulatoryStandards.title: Occupational Safety & Health Administration Air Contaminant Limits for Ozone and Nitrogen Dioxide
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Workplace ambient ozone must not exceed 0.1 ppm (0.2 mg/m3) 8-hour TWA ceiling; nitrogen dioxide (NO2) must not exceed 5.0 ppm ceiling. Continuous plasma lines must incorporate catalytic ozone destruct units.

regulatoryStandards.title: Guidelines on the Application of General Principles of Food Hygiene to the Control of Listeria monocytogenes in Foods
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Strict validation of pathogen destruction kinetic parameters (D-value and z-value equivalents) without degrading product safety, sensory profile, or nutritional composition.

regulatoryStandards.title: Safety and Efficacy of Cold Atmospheric Plasma (CAP) for In-Package Surface Decontamination
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Limits dietary nitrate/nitrite intake from cold-plasma-treated foods and requires screening for potential carcinogenic volatile aldehydes (MDA, 4-HNE) generated by lipid peroxidation.
